title: Junior Data Engineer
requirements: We're looking for a junior data engineer to join our small analytics platform team supporting grocery retail operations. You should be comfortable writing SQL for everyday reporting and ad hoc questions from merchandising and store ops. Proficiency in Python for scripting and light ETL work is expected. Experience with dbt for building and testing transformation models is required, even if gained through coursework, internships, or personal projects. Familiarity with Airflow or a similar orchestration tool for scheduling pipelines is a must. This is an entry-level role: 0-2 years of professional experience is fine, and we're happy to mentor someone early in their data career. A degree in computer science, data science, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory.
responsibilities: You will build and maintain dbt models that power weekly sales and inventory dashboards used by store planning and merchandising teams. You'll write and maintain Airflow DAGs that move point-of-sale and inventory data from source systems into our warehouse on a nightly schedule. Day to day, you'll troubleshoot failed pipeline runs, add data-quality tests to catch bad joins or duplicate records before they reach dashboards, and respond to SQL questions from category managers. You'll pair with a senior engineer on larger schema changes and gradually take ownership of specific pipelines as you ramp up. Some weeks include documenting existing pipelines so other teams can self-serve basic queries.
construction_rationale: Grade 3: exact title/level match, full core stack (SQL, Python, dbt, Airflow), grocery-retail domain, junior seniority — squarely the role Eve searches for.

title: Data Engineer I
requirements: Threadline is hiring a Data Engineer I to support our fashion e-commerce data platform. Candidates need solid SQL skills for querying and validating data across our order, inventory, and customer tables, plus working Python skills for scripting transformations and light automation. Hands-on experience with dbt, including writing models and tests, is required. Experience scheduling and monitoring jobs with Airflow is also required. This is a Level I role intended for engineers early in their career, roughly 1-2 years of relevant experience, including internships. We value curiosity and a willingness to learn our stack over years of tenure. Retail or e-commerce industry exposure is a plus but not required.
responsibilities: In this role you will maintain dbt models that transform raw order and inventory events into clean tables used by demand planning and marketing analytics. You will write Airflow DAGs to orchestrate daily ingestion from our e-commerce platform and third-party logistics feeds, and monitor those DAGs for failures. You'll write SQL to investigate data discrepancies flagged by business stakeholders and fix root causes in the transformation layer. You will also contribute to dbt test coverage so that seasonal sales spikes don't silently break downstream reports. Expect to work closely with a senior data engineer who reviews your pull requests and helps you scope larger projects.
construction_rationale: Grade 3: entry-level Data Engineer I title, full core stack (SQL, Python, dbt, Airflow), fashion e-commerce domain, junior seniority.

title: Associate Data Engineer
requirements: Marketway operates an online marketplace connecting independent sellers with shoppers, and we're hiring an Associate Data Engineer for our data platform team. You'll need strong SQL skills for exploring transactional and catalog data, and working knowledge of Python for pipeline scripting. dbt experience is required, including building models and writing tests. You should also have hands-on experience with Airflow for scheduling and monitoring workflows. We expect candidates to have around one to two years of experience, whether from a prior junior role, internship, or bootcamp plus project work. This role reports to a senior data engineer and is designed as a growth path toward more autonomous ownership over time.
responsibilities: You will build dbt models that transform raw marketplace transaction and listing data into tables used by seller-payout and demand-forecasting teams. You will write and maintain Airflow DAGs that pull data from our order and seller APIs on a daily cadence, and you'll be the first responder when a DAG fails overnight. Using SQL, you'll investigate anomalies such as missing seller payouts or mismatched order counts and propose fixes. You will add dbt tests to guard against these issues recurring. You'll also help document data lineage for new tables so analysts across the company can trust and reuse them.
construction_rationale: Grade 3: Associate Data Engineer is a synonym junior title, full core stack present, online marketplace (e-commerce) domain, junior seniority.

title: jr. data engineer (retail data team)
requirements: hey! we're basket & co, a scrappy online grocery delivery startup, and we need a jr. data engineer to help us keep our data pipelines from falling over. you should know sql well enough to debug a gnarly join at 2am (kidding, we don't do that, but you get the idea), and be comfortable writing python for glue scripts. we build everything in dbt so you'll need real hands-on experience there, not just "i read about it once." airflow runs our whole pipeline schedule so you should know your way around dags, sensors, and retries. we're not fussy about years of experience, more about whether you can actually ship things. 0-2 years is the sweet spot. bonus points if you've worked on anything retail or e-commerce flavored before.
responsibilities: day to day you'll be building and fixing dbt models that turn our raw order and delivery data into stuff the ops team actually trusts. you'll write airflow dags to pull inventory feeds from our warehouse partners every night and page yourself (well, us) when something breaks. you'll spend a good chunk of time writing sql to chase down why a dashboard number looks wrong, then fixing it upstream instead of patching it downstream. you'll add tests in dbt so the same bug doesn't come back next sprint. you'll pair with our one senior engineer pretty often at first, less so as you get comfortable owning your own pipelines.
construction_rationale: Grade 3: startup-casual register, junior title, full core stack (SQL, Python, dbt, Airflow), online grocery delivery domain, junior seniority.

title: Data Engineer, Entry Level
requirements: Northfield Home Retail, an omnichannel home goods retailer, seeks an entry-level Data Engineer to join our analytics engineering group. The successful candidate will demonstrate proficiency in SQL for data exploration and validation, and working knowledge of Python for pipeline development and automation tasks. Experience building transformation models and tests in dbt is required. Familiarity with orchestrating and monitoring data workflows in Airflow is required. This position is aimed at candidates in the early stage of their career, typically zero to two years post-graduation, including relevant internship experience. Exposure to retail, e-commerce, or supply chain data is preferred. A bachelor's degree in a quantitative field is preferred but relevant project experience will also be considered.
responsibilities: The Data Engineer will develop and maintain dbt models that transform point-of-sale, e-commerce, and inventory data into curated tables for merchandising and finance reporting. Daily tasks include monitoring Airflow DAGs that ingest data from store systems and our e-commerce platform, resolving failed tasks, and escalating persistent issues. The role involves writing SQL queries to validate data accuracy after upstream schema changes and building automated tests in dbt to catch regressions early. The engineer will collaborate with senior team members on pipeline design decisions and will gradually take on independent ownership of specific data domains as proficiency grows.
construction_rationale: Grade 3: formal register, entry-level title, full core stack, omnichannel home-goods retail domain, junior seniority.

title: Data Analyst
requirements: Cascade Outfitters, an outdoor apparel retailer, is looking for a Data Analyst to support our merchandising and marketing teams. Strong SQL skills are essential for querying our warehouse and building recurring reports. Working proficiency in Python is expected for data cleaning and lightweight automation of recurring analyses. Experience with dbt is a plus, as our small analytics team uses it for shared transformation logic, but it is not a strict requirement if you're a fast learner. Comfort with pandas for exploratory analysis is expected. Candidates typically have zero to three years of experience in an analyst or junior data role. Familiarity with retail sales or inventory data is helpful.
responsibilities: You will write SQL queries to answer recurring business questions from merchandising and marketing stakeholders, such as sell-through rates by category or campaign performance. You'll use Python and pandas to clean and reshape data pulled from our warehouse before building reports. You will occasionally contribute simple dbt models when the analytics engineering team needs an extra pair of hands, under their guidance. You'll present findings in weekly syncs with merchandising, and maintain a handful of recurring SQL-based reports. Over time you may take on small automation projects to reduce manual reporting work.
construction_rationale: Grade 2: adjacent title (Data Analyst, no 'junior' qualifier) with entry-level scope, most of core stack (dbt only a nice-to-have, no Airflow ownership), retail domain, junior/mid band.

title: Analytics Engineer

Python skills are expected for occasional scripting, though most day-to-day work happens in SQL and dbt. This role does not directly own our orchestration layer; a separate platform team manages Airflow, so prior Airflow experience is nice to have but not required. We're open to candidates with one to three years of experience, including those coming from an analyst background who want to move toward engineering. Any prior exposure to retail, logistics, or supply chain data is a plus.
responsibilities: You will design and build dbt models that transform raw operational data into analysis-ready tables for the finance and operations teams. You'll write SQL to validate transformation logic and investigate discrepancies reported by stakeholders. You will collaborate with the platform team to understand how your dbt models fit into the broader Airflow-orchestrated pipeline, occasionally proposing scheduling changes to them rather than implementing those changes yourself. You'll document model logic and column definitions so downstream analysts can self-serve. You'll also review pull requests from other analytics engineers on the team as you gain experience.
construction_rationale: Grade 2: adjacent title (Analytics Engineer), core stack minus Airflow (owned by a separate platform team), domain unstated/adjacent (logistics/supply chain), junior-to-mid band.

title: Junior Data Analyst / Data Engineer
requirements: Harborlight Retail Group is hiring for a hybrid data analyst / data engineer position supporting our store operations and e-commerce reporting. You should have strong SQL skills and comfort with Python for scripting and data manipulation, including pandas for exploratory work. Experience with dbt for transformation modeling is expected, though we're flexible on depth if your SQL and Python fundamentals are strong. You'll use Python and pandas for one-off data cleaning tasks and small automation scripts that save the team manual work. You will also help maintain documentation for the growing library of dbt models the team has built, and mentor newer analysts on writing cleaner SQL.
construction_rationale: Grade 2: adjacent hybrid title without 'junior' qualifier, core stack minus Airflow (central team owns orchestration), retail domain, seniority bumped to mid (still within accepted band).

title: Junior Data Engineer (Reporting & Dashboards)

You should have strong SQL skills for querying our data warehouse and building efficient queries behind dashboards. Hands-on experience with Looker, including building LookML models and explores, is required. Some Python experience for occasional data cleaning is a plus. No experience with data pipeline or orchestration tools is expected for this role, as our IT team handles data extraction and loading.

You'll write basic SQL queries to pull data from our point-of-sale system when a report requires a custom cut of data. You will consolidate data from multiple store locations into a single reporting workbook, checking for and correcting obvious data entry errors along the way. You'll respond to requests from store managers for one-off analyses, such as comparing promotion performance across regions. construction_rationale: Grade 1 skill-missing: retail domain and junior/entry level match, but the role centers on Excel/Tableau spreadsheet-heavy reporting instead of a real data pipeline, with no dbt or Airflow — same skill-missing axis as the Looker posting, different angle.

title: Data Engineer
requirements: Hearthstone Home & Garden, a home improvement retailer with both physical stores and an online storefront, is hiring a Data Engineer to own key parts of our data platform. Strong SQL and Python skills are required. Deep hands-on experience with dbt, including designing model layers and writing comprehensive tests, is required. Solid experience with Airflow, including designing DAGs from scratch and handling complex dependencies, is required. We're looking for candidates with three to five years of experience who can operate independently: you should be able to take a pipeline from initial design through production ownership with minimal oversight. Retail or e-commerce data experience is preferred.
responsibilities: You will independently design, build, and own dbt models that transform point-of-sale, e-commerce, and supply chain data into tables used across the company. You will design and maintain Airflow DAGs for complex multi-source pipelines, making architectural decisions about dependencies, retries, and backfills without needing sign-off from a more senior engineer. You'll use SQL to diagnose and resolve data issues end to end, from root cause to production fix. You will set technical direction for how new data sources get modeled, and you'll be expected to work with minimal supervision, escalating only genuinely ambiguous business questions rather than technical ones.
construction_rationale: Grade 1 off-by-one seniority: full core stack and retail/home-improvement domain match exactly, but seniority is explicitly mid (one level above Eve, still within her accepted retrieval range) and asks for unsupervised end-to-end pipeline ownership.

You'll participate in code review, both giving and receiving feedback on pull requests. construction_rationale: Grade 0 wrong stack: 'Junior' and 'Engineer' in the title but frontend/React/JavaScript stack with none of Eve's data stack (SQL, Python, dbt, Airflow) — multiple axes wrong.
